ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Saturn

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
From {H:1804973428000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
From {H:1804973428000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
From {H:1804973428000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
From {H:1804973428000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
From {H:1804973428000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
From {H:1804973428000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
From {H:1804973428000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
From {H:1804973428000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
From {H:1804973428000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
From {H:1804973428000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
From {H:1804973428000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.
